checks.name: Identifier domains
checks.output: A zero MAX_BYTES ceiling fails with zero_bound. The exact eight-byte boundary round-trips for ASCII and for a two-character eight-byte UTF-8 value; one byte over fails with too_long carrying max_bytes and actual_bytes. Empty, NUL, newline and U+007F values fail. Four control-free spellings stay opaque and uninterpreted. Unlike domains are separate types: the compile_fail doctest on OpaqueId is rejected with E0308 mismatched types.

checks.name: Text bounds
checks.output: Zero ceiling, empty, exact-boundary and one-byte-over cases are covered. A decomposed 'e + U+0301' is preserved byte-for-byte and is not normalized to U+00E9; a value one byte over the ceiling is rejected rather than truncated. Tab, carriage return, newline and U+009F are rejected.

checks.name: Time and revision
checks.output: Negative, zero and positive epoch instants decompose with a non-negative 0..=999 remainder, so -1 ms yields (-1, 999) and -1001 ms yields (-2, 999). Eight instants round-trip through decomposition. A 1000 ms remainder fails with millisecond_out_of_range; i64::MAX seconds, i64::MAX + 1 ms, i64::MIN - 1 ms and an overflowing difference all fail with overflow. Revision rejects zero, starts at 1, and u64::MAX successor fails with overflow rather than wrapping.

checks.name: URL safety
checks.output: 11 URLs accepted and 32 rejected, all offline with no DNS lookup or socket. Accepted: DNS names, IPv4, bracketed IPv6 including ::1, optional ports and paths; the exact 32-byte ceiling passes and 33 bytes fails. Rejected with their own categories: ftp/file/javascript/no scheme and uppercase HTTP (scheme), 'http://' and 'http://:443' and 'http://:443/path' (empty_host), userinfo forms (user_info), fragment, backslash, whitespace, non-ASCII host, leading-dash and empty-label hosts (host), unclosed and malformed IPv6 brackets, port 0, 65536, empty, non-decimal, signed and leading-zero ports (port), and a control character.

checks.name: Secret safety
checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test primitives && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --doc
checks.output: Zero ceiling, empty and one-byte-over inputs fail; the exact eight-byte UTF-8 boundary passes. Debug renders a constant '<redacted>' and two secrets of different lengths render identically, so length is not inferable. Four rejection paths were rendered through both Display and Debug and none contained the synthetic value. Compile-fail coverage passes and was confirmed to fail for the intended reasons: E0277 for absent Display, the same absence removing to_string, and E0616 for the private field. Every secret used is a synthetic literal invented for the test.

checks.name: Quality
checks.command: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --workspace --offline
checks.output: Formatting is clean, strict all-target Clippy exits 0 with zero warnings, and 204 workspace tests pass offline. No allowance was added, no dependency was added, and rust/Cargo.toml and rust/Cargo.lock are unchanged by this work.

review.acceptance: primary-session self-review only; not independent, and no second reviewer examined this slice

extra_checks.name: Error category coverage
extra_checks.command: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p automonique-protocol --offline --test primitives every_rejection_has_a_stable_category
extra_checks.output: 16 distinct stable error categories are asserted: zero_bound, empty, too_long, control_character, non_ascii, whitespace, scheme, user_info, fragment, backslash, empty_host, host, port, millisecond_out_of_range, overflow and zero_revision.

extra_checks.name: Compile-fail intent
extra_checks.output: A temporary scratch test compiled the three forbidden expressions and produced exactly E0277 (SecretText has no Display), E0616 (private field) and E0308 (OpaqueId domains not interchangeable), proving the compile_fail doctests fail for their intended reasons rather than incidentally. The scratch file was removed and is not part of the candidate.
